tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_sandking_burrowstri:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.

Burrowstrike becomes a vector-targeted ability, allowing Sand King to create a secondary burrowstrike past his initial target location. The secondary burrowstrike distance and damage can be up to %underground_distance_pct%%% of a normal burrowstrike.
Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_sandking_sand_storm: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.
Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.
Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.
Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_sandking_epicenter_: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.
The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.

When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).
Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_sand_king_bio: The sands of the Scintillant Waste are alive and sentient--the whole vast desert speaks to itself, thinking thoughts only such a vastness can conceive. But when it needs must find a form to communicate with those of more limited scope, it frees a fragment of itself, and fills a carapace of magic armor formed by the cunning Djinn of Qaldin. This essential identity calls itself Crixalis, meaning 'Soul of the Sand,' but others know it as Sand King.  Sand King takes the form of a huge arachnid, inspired by the Scintillant Waste's small but ubiquitous denizens; and this is a true outward expression of his ferocious nature. Guardian, warrior, ambassador--Sand King is all of these things, inseparable from the endless desert that gave him life.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_sand_king_hype: Not many can survive an ambush from Sand King. Demolishing everything around him with waves of deadly vibration from his ultimate, he evades counterattacks by hiding himself in a scouring gust of sand, and stuns foes by striking them from beneath.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: An injection from Crixalis makes one brittle and as dry as the arid wastes, subject to implosive demise.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Injects a venom per successful attack that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die.

The damage radius is centered on Sand King.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: The higher Sand King's level, the greater the damage applied.

fields.name: debuff1text
fields.value: Caustic Finale: Injected with venom from Sand King's attacks. You will explode on death, dealing radius damage.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|sand_king_caustic_finale_orb}}
** Considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, and {{M|illusions}} as creeps.
** Applies the debuff in the following conditions:
*** A successful attack.
*** On {{A|Sand King|Burrowstrike}}-affected enemy units.
*** On {{A|Sand King|Stinger}}-affected enemy units, including the {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{A|Sand King|Epicenter|text=Epicenter Spines}}.
** Reapplying the existing debuff refreshes the duration, but does not update the ability values.
*** All ability values are set upon the initial debuff application.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Procs the radius damage upon the debuff-affected unit being killed by an enemy unit.
** Does not proc in the following conditions:
*** When the either {{M|summons}} or {{M|illusions}} expiring.
*** Upon being {{M|denied}}.
*** When killed without a credited source.
*** Affected by {{M|forced kill}} sources.

* Does not apply the debuff on the following units:
** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
** {{M|Buildings}}
** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above Sand King as he resurfaces.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Burrow and strikes in the point-targeted direction, without needing to reach the required cast range.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Applies a Caustic Finale debuff of its corresponding level on all affected enemy units upon resurfacing.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Does not break the Sand Storm invisibility component upon cast, if Burrowstrike ends within the Sand Storm radius, but not other invisibility sources.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Creates a sandstorm that damages enemy units within the radius. The sandstorm immediately dissipates upon leaving the effect radius.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Grants self invisibility with a fade delay, within the sand storm radius.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Sand Storm now additionally blinds and applies movement speed slow to enemy units within the radius.

fields.name: buff2text
fields.value: Sand Storm: Turns you invisible and applies x damage every second to nearby units.

fields.name: debuff1text
fields.value: Sand Storm: Movement speed slowed by x%.

fields.name: debuff2text
fields.value: Sand Storm Blind: Missing x% of attacks.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Aura}}
** The [[aura]] linger duration affects all ability components.
** Creates an aura upon cast that applies the following ability effects in {{#var:Sand Storm basic1}}-second intervals, starting immediately upon debuff application, over {{calc|trunc((v1+{{#var:Sand Storm value4}})/{{#var:Sand Storm basic1}})|v1={{#var:Sand Storm value3}}}} max possible instances:
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Deals {{calc|v1*{{#var:Sand Storm basic1}}|v1={{#var:Sand Storm value2}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2r}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*{{#var:Sand Storm basic1}}|v1={{#var:Sand Storm value2 tal}}}}|15tal}}) {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} per interval.
**** {{cf|talnotes}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|sand_storm_slow}}
***** The {{M|movement speed}} slow.
***** Applies {{Symbol|Blind}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|sandking_sand_storm_blind}} per successful attack on the attacked enemy unit while active.
****** [[Evasion#Stacking|Stacks]] additively with other [[blind]] sources and multiplicatively with {{M|evasion}} sources.
****** The debuff-affected attacking unit's miss chance uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proctal|{{#var:Sand Storm type2 value2}}}}.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
**** Grants {{M|invisibility}} immediately upon cast.
***** Sand King will keep turning invisible for the entire duration.
***** During the {{M|fade delay}}, Sand King can still attack and cast abilities.
***** Does not grant {{M|phase movement}}.
***** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|sandking_sand_storm}}
****** Sources with fade delays utilize the {{Code|modifier_invisible}} buff.
****** Buff sources of the same modifier do not stack, the longer duration buff takes precedence when the same modifier is applied.
****** Sand King can pick up or drop items without breaking invisibility.
****** The invisibility breaks upon {{M|attack point}}, or the abilities' {{M|cast point}}.
***** However, since Sand Storm applies the invisiblity immediately, the fade delay does not take effect when re-casting it within the previous radius.

fields.value: Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
After its cast point, Sand King causes the ground beneath to shudder violently. All enemy units within the radius are damaged and slowed.

Each subsequent pulse increases the Epicenter radius.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Each Epicenter pulse now randomly summons multiple Stinger spines of its corresponding level, at random locations within its radius.

The spine radius is a portion of the current Epicenter radius, and can only affect the same enemy units once per pulse.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value:
Passively releases a lesser Epicenter pulse at a fixed duration.

Increases pulse damage.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: The Stinger spines of Epicenter pulses now additionally apply the instant attack component.

fields.name: dt desc0
fields.value: The fixed duration is neither affected by cooldown reset sources nor percentage-based cooldown reduction sources.

abilities: Blink + Burrowstrike + Epicenter is a classic AoE stun-and-nuke teamfight opener.
Sentries and dust reveal his Sand Storm escape and stop the blink initiation.
items: Dust of Appearance reveals Sand King through invisibility.
Linken's Sphere blocks Sand King's key single-target spell.
Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Sand King's magic damage and disables.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Sand King's targeted disable.
Pipe of Insight shields your team from Sand King's AoE magic damage.
Eul's Scepter (or any stun) interrupts Sand King's channelled spell.
Spell immunity to fight through disables and magic.
Armor and an AoE slow that cuts healing.
A chance to bash and stun in fights.
An ability upgrade for extra utility.
To recast your ultimate twice in a fight.
